title: BuildBar
description: Aktif projenin tasks.json gorevlerini ve launch.json yapilandirmalarini kalici butonlarda gosterir

title: Codex Session Notifier
description: Monitor local and SSH Codex sessions and receive reply completion notifications through pushplus channels.

title: Dev Assistant Toolkit
description: A collection of handy developer utilities for VS Code: GitHub PR & Jira task tracking, Base64/URL/JSON tools, UUIDs, timestamps, and case conversions.

title: Spyglass for Avalonia
description: XAML hot reload for running Avalonia apps: unsaved .axaml edits update the app as you type. Free and open source.

title: Tide Syntax
description: Syntax highlighting for the Tide language (.tid files).

title: Roaming Pixel Cats
description: Tiny pixel-art cats that roam your whole VS Code window: they walk, nap, jump between panels, climb up and slide down.

title: Doctor — Markdown to SharePoint Pages
description: Write and publish the Markdown that doctor turns into SharePoint pages: edit front matter with pickers for your SharePoint columns, edit doctor.json in a form, and run doctor publish and status from VS Code.

title: DocPresenter Diagram
description: Draw diagrams as text or on a canvas: flowcharts and free-form drawings in .dgm files, with highlighting, suggestions, formatting and SVG export. Every change is a readable Git diff.
